programme.desc: Pups Save a Trophy; Pups Save the Wind Trekkers. programme.desc: Pups Stop the Garboni; Pups Save the Porcupine. Farmer Al's new machine, the Garboni, goes haywire, and it's up to Ryder and the Paw Patrol to stop it before it gives them the slip; the Paw Patrol have to catch a trouble-making sleepy porcupine and bring it back to the woods.

programme.desc: Pups Save a Manatee; Pups Save Breakfast. Farmer Al and Farmer Yumi need help from the PAW Patrol to get a manatee to the swamp; Mr. Porter and Alex get into a sticky situation involving maple syrup.
